headline: The Colts get a first down
what_happened: On their fourth and final try, the Colts ran the ball forward to gain enough yards to keep their turn with the ball.
who: J.Taylor ran the ball while C.Jones defended for the Chiefs.
why_it_matters: This is bad news for the Chiefs because it keeps the Colts' drive alive, increasing their chances of winning by 8 percentage points. Since the Chiefs are still ahead 10-7, they will need their defense to step up.
